Maharashtra FDA Suspends Licenses, Seizes Adulterated Food

The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in Maharashtra has suspended the licenses of five establishments and seized adulterated ghee. In Pune, the FDA suspended the licenses of two restaurants and seized food items worth Rs 1.18 crore as part of a special inspection drive conducted across the state, considering the festive season.
